summary.overall_note: Only 3 of 30 sampled features (978 emotion-regulation, 1740 emotional-subtext-of-phrasing, 4037 familial-emotional-context) look genuinely semantic, and even those are largely confined to the EMOTIONS domain. The high-frequency band is dominated by Gandhi/Science/Hindi slot-filling templates and Hindi-script markers, the median band mixes templates with domain markers, and almost all of the rarest 'alive' features are effectively dead singletons or the one ubiquitous always-on unit (3902). Genuine concepts are the exception, not the rule, at this width.
